City Council Room
Austin Texas May 09, 1873
The Board of Aldermen sitting as a Court of Appeals Ald. T. E. Sneed as president called
the Court to order, the Roll was called.
Present: Ald. T.E. Sneed E. Bremond,
" " R.H. Boardman W.m Brueggerhoff
" J.H. Robinson J.W. Bruning
Absent : A. Scholz Geo. Susemann.
On motion of Ald. Robinson the improvements on North half of Lot 2, in Block 69,
improvements on South half of Lot 2 in Block 69, improvements on South half of 3 in Block
69 were revised to four thousand dollars each half, and improvements on Lot five in Block
69 were raised to eight thousand dollars.
Ald. Robinson moved to reduce the Assessment on Lots 1 & 2 in Block 173 from $600 each to
$750 each, which motion was carried.
On motion of Ald. Bremond : Lot 4 in Block 81 was raised to $750 and Lots 5 & 6 in same
Block to $100 each.
Ald. Bremond moved that the Assessment of the old city limits for the year 1873 now stands
as corrected, and the Court of Appeals adjourn semi die; the President thereof shall
certify to the same, and deliver the Assessment to the Mayor, which motion was unanimously
carried. Fred Sleying
Recorder

City Council Room
Austin Texas May 9th 1873
Called meeting
His Honor J. W. Wheeler called the Council to order, the Roll was called.
Present: Ald. T.E. Sneed, E. Bremond J.H.Robinson " W.m Brueggerhoff R.H. Boardman J.W.
Bruning
Absent: Geo. Susemann A. Scholz
Ald. Sneed moved that a Committee of three be appointed to confer with Mr. D. Humbolt in
regard to water works, which motion was carried. His Honor the Mayor appointed on that
Committee Ald. Sneed Robinson and Boardman, on motion the Mayor was added to the
Committee. On motion the Council adjourned. Fred Sleying Recorder
